definitions.definition: (transitive) To prove (something) to be false or incorrect.

quote.citation: 1791, James Boswell, The life of Samuel Johnson, LL. D.‎[1]:
quote.text: After we came out of the church, we stood talking for some time together of Bishop Berkeley's ingenious sophistry to prove the non-existence of matter, and that every thing in the universe is merely ideal. I observed, that though we are satisfied his doctrine is not true, it is impossible to refute it. I never shall forget the alacrity with which Johnson answered, striking his foot with mighty force against a large stone, till he rebounded from it, "I refute it thus."

definitions.definition: (transitive, proscribed) To deny the truth or correctness of (something).
